- Venue: Aurora HQ Civic Center, 3rd floor (site_map.png attached).
- Goals: align exec stakeholders on deployment roadmap, gather prioritization decisions, and map success metrics.

Immediate asks (please reply by EOD Mon):
1) Presenter owners for the blocks in the attached agenda v1 (I put placeholders in column D). Confirm who will lead each block and who owns the slide deck.
2) Deck deadline: internal slide drop to me by Thu 4/22 so we can stitch and do run-throughs. Finalized decks due Tue 5/3.
3) Prework: we need a 2-page pre-read for attendees by Mon 4/29. Who will own the pre-read content for each section?
4) Logistics: Sergio, can you confirm AV run-of-show and on-site tech contact?

Attachments: draft_agenda_v1.pdf, site_map.png. Working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-Workshop-Prep

Kate / Lucien — would appreciate any attendee constraints (dietary, travel windows, security) so we can bake in arrival instructions.

Thanks — I assigned initial placeholders but flexible. Once we lock presenters, I'll publish the prework schedule and the 'what to bring' note for attendees.
